name: gr_connected_of_many_edges
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : (Fintype.card V - 1).choose 2 < G.edgeFinset.card) : G.Connected
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : (Fintype.card V - 1).choose 2 < G.edgeFinset.card), G.Connected
informal: A graph with more than C(n−1,2) edges is connected — otherwise (using Mathlib2.comb_compl_connected_of_not_connected style splitting) V splits into nonempty parts of sizes k and n−k with no edges between, so e ≤ C(k,2) + C(n−k,2) ≤ C(n−1,2) for 1 ≤ k ≤ n−1.
type: ∀ (V : Type) [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj], (Fintype.card V - 1).choose 2 < G.edgeFinset.card → G.Connected
